author: Paraskis
quote: Good evening, Metacritic.I bought a basic PS5 specifically to play GTA 6, spending €800 in total. I connected it to my good-quality TV, but the game suffers from constant stuttering, screen flickering, and a complete lack of smoothness.I'm not an expert and I don't have any technical knowledge. However, the game is simply unplayable for me. Unfortunately, I now feel that I have no choice but to sell both my console and the game.I did some research just now and found out that there might be an issue with the FPS, as the frame rate seems to drop dramatically. Does this mean the game has poor performance?It's such a shame. I'm genuinely disappointed because I was really looking forward to playing it, but I couldn't even enjoy the experience.Since I haven't actually been able to play the game, my rating will have to be an absolute zero.Maybe this game is better suited for PC. What can I say...
